scope: Independent semantic review of four declared session-renewal synchronization rows and the target-versus-reality boundary.

checks.criteria_block_hash_method: Exact UTF-8 acceptance_criteria YAML block, including its field name and terminating newline.

primary_source_reading.finding: Mouse, keyboard, and scroll activity and refresh-token recovery are intended.
Continued activity must support continued renewal. The user separately requests gap analysis.

semantic_conclusions: The requirement preserves the original activity, duration, pending, success, and retry targets.
The topic links to canonical criteria. It does not substitute the trailing-timer implementation for the requested activity behavior.
Source conflicts remain proposed timing designs. The correction selects no new production timeout.
The independent gap document retains actual source, bounded conformance, failed assertions, remote UAT limits, and deployment unknowns.
IR-C01 records restored manual-recovery conformance separately. It creates no new intended rule.
The index now directs target-rule retrieval and actual conformance to distinct records.
Both changed records remain candidate drafts with empty human verification lists.

restoring_fix_workflow_review.kind: hypothetical procedure review; no application execution
inputs: A bugfix restores an existing AC.
restoring_fix_workflow_review.expected_disposition: Keep the intended rule unchanged. Record a supported knowledge no-change row. Update independent gap disposition and release evidence.
restoring_fix_workflow_review.actual_skill_disposition: The revised skill explicitly requires this no-change disposition and separates gap updates from target-rule successors.
limits: Local passing evidence closes only the demonstrated boundary.
Local evidence does not establish PROD realization or remote UAT qualification.
A restoring fix supplies no knowledge-publication approval.

remaining_limits: KS-03 and KS-04 checks cover unchanged dependency consistency. They do not recurate all older SDK or architecture knowledge.
The independent gap review checks retained evidence. It introduces no new runtime execution.
RN-X003 does not establish execution of delivered stale-response rejection.
RN-S002 is an inherited isolated failure against proposed security intent. Policy authority and actual protected-operation impact remain unresolved.
Remote UAT remains NOT_RUN. Current PROD artifact, configuration, cohort, and effective interval remain unknown.
Human review, provenance checkpoint completion, report parity, and publication remain separate stage checks.
Agent review does not authenticate actors, prove infinite execution, or grant business approval.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
